title: The Amazing Venom #3
desc:
IT'S A SPACE JAM!

Comeback has made it to SPACE! But their spaceship needs fuel!

In the latest part of Fred's plan to help Passenger return home to Klyntar, the duo have made a pit stop in Knowhere, home to travelers, smugglers, outcasts galore — AND Rocket Raccoon!!!

Will Knowhere be an easy layover, or is Comeback in for some trouble???
